lines.label: Federal income tax
lines.note: Withheld at the supplemental rate (22%); the amount is the extra regular tax the vest value adds at your brackets (Single, standard deduction).

source.title: IRS Publication 15 (2026), What's New and section 7 (Supplemental Wages)

lines.label: Social Security (6.2%)
lines.note: Up to the $184,500 wage base, counting the salary first.

source.title: IRS Publication 15 (2026), (Circular E), section 9: Tax rates and the social security wage base limit; IRS Tax Topic 560, Additional Medicare Tax

lines.label: California income tax withholding
lines.note: The state's supplemental withholding method (flat). The state's final liability on the vest value is not computed here; it is settled on the state return. California's flat rate for bonuses and stock options; other supplemental pay (overtime, commissions, severance, vacation) uses 6.6%.

source.title: California EDD Publication DE 44 (Rev. 52 (4-26)), 2026 California Employer's Guide — How to Withhold PIT on Supplemental Wages

notes: RSUs: the market value of the shares delivered at vest is wages (Pub 525, restricted property: FMV minus any amount paid). Your cost basis is that value; the holding period starts at vest.
Tax at sale uses the 2026 brackets with your salary as the other income of the year of sale. State tax on capital gains is not computed.
Estimate only, not tax advice: the plan documents, your other income, deductions and credits change the result.
